title: a person outside an open market joins its waitlist

criteria.text: Every US zip resolves to a market before launch; nothing is selected from a list
criteria.note: Restated 2026-10-11 (F103). `zip_county` and `counties` hold the national Census ZCTA table; `zip_market_key()` resolves a zip, a county no market names is its own waiting market; Connecticut's 288 zips landed in #959 (#905) [V migrations]. Checked: `[guards F076.1]` in `tests/f076-every-zip-market-db.test.ts` (#907), seen failing on main (CT missing) and against three mutants [V PR body]. Nothing merged for it since 2026-10-23 [V git log]. Reviewed no: #709 review-skipped, #907 and #959 carry no first-pass `Reviewed by:` [V]. Shipped: Deploy health green on 4f571f5c, 4f691c01, 8659ee4a [V]. Smoked: run 39291029395 (2026-10-19, main cd913c7d, after #959) opened join and onboarding, green; the daily runs since cover root and explore only [V smoke-live.yml]. #843 closed 2026-10-18.

criteria.text: The platform never selects a market for the person: no IP, default, nearest match or shortlist; the zip decides
criteria.note: `[guards F076.2]` in `tests/f076-never-rules.test.ts` scans the waitlist, onboarding and explore surfaces for IP, geolocation, distance and pre-checked controls [V]. No IP guess in src; `explore_vantage` reads the member's own zip inside the database (#932) [V]. Reviewed no (#709 review-skipped). Shipped yes (4f571f5c). Smoked: explore green daily 10-24 to 10-30 (run 41093000135 on 09ffba30, 2026-10-30); join and onboarding on 2026-10-19 [V].

criteria.text: The waitlist entry records make or find, neither pre-selected; no role is stored on the member
criteria.note: Split 2026-10-30: 3a is the entry and the no-role rule, 3b the discard. `metro_waitlist.role`, no default, no pre-selected radio, no role column on any member table [V migration 20260914204920, MetroNotCoveredPanel]. `[guards F076.3]` in `tests/f076-never-rules.test.ts` scans every migration for a role, creator or patron column on a person table and allow-lists the three files that may read the waitlist role (the two join handlers and the opener) [V]. Built by #86 (no `Reviewed by:`, no Deploy health run for 640e1fc2) and #768 (622a12d9 green) [V]. Smoked unknown: the panel is reached only by picking a waiting market, which no smoke does.

criteria.text: The make-or-find answer is discarded when the market opens
criteria.note: New since 2026-10-23: `openMarket` (#1056, `src/lib/market/open-market.ts`) deletes every member row of the market's waitlist once it is open, which is the role going with it [V lines 84-88]. Checked no: `open-market.test.ts` exercises the open but its only marker is `[guards F076.15 partial]`; nothing claims 3 [V]. Reviewed no: #1056 says `Reviewed by: build lane` [V]. Shipped: Deploy health 40259728284 green on 66e50b13 [V]. Smoked unknown: an operator script, not a route. #616 listed the discard as missing item 3; it is now the check that is missing. Filed #1118 (check, launch-blocking, Beta).

criteria.text: One person counts once in one market, whether they signed up or only left an email
criteria.note: Member row unique by `member_id`; address row unique by `lower(email)`; a member who had left an address is folded into the member row (#763, #613) [V handlers]. `[guards F076.4]` x2 in `waitlist-join.test.ts` plus a partial for the reverse order in `waitlist-join-anonymous.test.ts` [V]. Reviewed no: #86, #191, #197 carry no `Reviewed by:`. Shipped unknown: no Deploy health run for 640e1fc2 (#86); 6df9b932, 0ac5c54f, 0ae50d98 green [V]. Smoked unknown: the anonymous panel is reached only by picking a waiting market, which no smoke does.

criteria.text: Changing the market moves the count; neither double-counted nor stranded
criteria.note: Both handlers update the row and move the counter in one transaction [V]. `[guards F076.5]` in `f076-criteria.test.ts` runs the move through both ways of joining (mocked database; mutants run by hand, #766) [V]. Built by #86, #191, #197: no `Reviewed by:`; Deploy health unknown for #86. Smoked unknown (as 4).

criteria.text: Creator and patron counts are stored separately and readable apart
criteria.note: `metro_polygons.creator_count` and `patron_count` (and the same on `markets`) [V migrations]. `[guards F076.6]` in `f076-criteria.test.ts` for both paths [V]. Built by #86; reviewed no, shipped unknown, smoked unknown (as 4).

criteria.text: After joining, a popup shows a count and a message, for everyone, from the cache
criteria.note: Built since 2026-10-23: #1031 (bug #686, #1030) gives `getMetroWaitingCounts` a cookie-free `createAnonClient()` inside `unstable_cache`, so the read no longer throws; both join actions call `waitingCountFor` and the panel opens `MetroStandingDialog` [V src/lib/metro/waitlist-counts.ts lines 95-109, MetroNotCoveredPanel.tsx]. Not reproduced on production today [A]. Checked no: `[guards F076.7 partial]` covers the signed-in popup only; the anonymous popup tests in `metro-waitlist-anonymous-actions.test.ts` and #1031's `waitlist-counts.test.ts` (seen failing before the fix) carry no marker [V]. Reviewed no: #217, #764 no first-pass review; #1031 `Reviewed by: build lane`, no GitHub review [V]. Shipped: Deploy health green on a3faf37c, 88724880 and 40096159765 on 0dbf6d8a [V]. Smoked unknown: the popup needs a join, which no smoke does. #686 and #1030 closed 2026-10-24. Filed #1118 (check, launch-blocking, Beta).

criteria.text: One combined number against the combined target, the same figure everywhere
criteria.note: Built since 2026-10-23: one cached read (`waitingCountByMetro`) serves the popup and the area picker, which Explore now receives instead of an empty map (#1031; `load.ts` lines 95 and 123) [V]. The target is `COMBINED_TARGET = 300` (50 + 250) [V waitlist-standing.ts]; the 2026-10-26 ruling (F118) moved the thresholds to 100 makers and 1,000 supporters, so the target moves with #1101 item 4 (change, `area:sign-in-you`, Beta) and the scenario's 300 reads as the combined threshold. Checked no: `[guards F076.8 partial]` covers the signed-in popup; the picker's ordering tests in `feed-metro-sort.test.ts` carry no marker [V]. Reviewed no (#217, #764, #1031 as 7). Shipped: a3faf37c, 88724880, 0dbf6d8a green [V]. Smoked: explore green daily 10-24 to 10-30 (run 41093000135); it loads the route, it does not open the picker [V]. A waiting vantage (F105.4, #699) is the other surface, unbuilt. Filed #1118 (check, launch-blocking, Beta).

criteria.text: The message says what is still needed and never a date, a timeline or a promise
criteria.note: `standingMessage` in `waitlist-standing.ts`; `[guards F076.9]` asserts no date or promise wording [V]. #1038 (2026-10-24, F103.4) swapped 'metro' for 'area' inside the message, no other change; the PM looks at it live. Draft PR #684 holds other wording (do not merge). Built by #86; reviewed no, shipped unknown (#86), smoked unknown (as 4).

criteria.text: A market is eligible only when both thresholds are met separately; the combined total alone is not enough
criteria.note: Split 2026-10-30: 10a is the two-gate rule, 10b the numbers. `metroStanding` gates on creators and patrons separately; `[guards F076.10]` as one table [V waitlist-standing.ts, .test.ts]. Built by #86; reviewed no, shipped unknown, smoked unknown.

criteria.text: The thresholds are 50 creators and 250 patrons
criteria.note: Overtaken by the 2026-10-26 ruling in F118 § Rulings: a market opens at 100 makers and 1,000 supporters, [replaces 2026-09-14: 50 creators and 250 patrons]. The code still defaults to 50/250 (`metro_polygons`, `markets` thresholds) [V migrations]; #1101 item 4 (change, `area:sign-in-you`, Beta) carries the update, and `sync-roadmap` amends the scenario. Shown, not counted.

criteria.text: Thresholds are configurable per market without a migration or a deploy
criteria.note: Threshold columns on `metro_polygons` and `markets` (defaults 50/250, an UPDATE changes them); `[guards F076.11]` scans for hard-coded thresholds and reads the column defaults [V]. Built by #86; reviewed no, shipped unknown, smoked unknown.

criteria.text: Opening a market is deliberate; crossing the threshold never opens it
criteria.note: Since #1056 the one writer of `is_open` is `scripts/market/open-market.ts`, run by a person; F118's daily round (`town_mark_ready`, #1093) marks a town ready and logs an Issue, never opens [V]. `[guards F076.12]` scans src, scripts and every migration except the two seeds and allow-lists only the opener [V tests/f076-never-rules.test.ts lines 128-152]. Built by #86 (no run), #1056 (66e50b13 green); reviewed no; smoked unknown.

criteria.text: A person can leave an email to be told when a market opens, with no account
criteria.note: `metro.waitlist_join_anonymous` and `MetroNotCoveredPanel`: address and role only, no password or name, one tap; since #1031 the standing popup follows instead of a page error [V]. `[guards F076.13]` drives the panel and asserts the exact call [V]. Built by #197, #198 (no `Reviewed by:`); Deploy health green on 0ac5c54f, 8ad3ee56. Smoked unknown: the panel is reached only by picking a waiting market, which no smoke does.

criteria.text: The response is identical whether or not the address was already there, the number included
criteria.note: The result carries no changed or created flag; the number is the cached figure (one hour), never a function of the submission, and since #1031 it actually reaches the screen [V]. `[guards F076.14]` runs the handler on a real database for a new, a repeated and another known address and expects byte-identical results, and scans that no other code reads the live counters [V]. Reviewed no (#197, #217); shipped yes (0ac5c54f, a3faf37c, 0dbf6d8a); smoked unknown (as 13).

criteria.text: An address is used only to say the market opened, then discarded
criteria.note: Built since 2026-10-23: #1056 adds `scripts/market/open-market.ts`, which opens the market, sends the ruled words ('SocialUs is open in {market}. See what's going on.') to each address on the landing list through the reminders' Resend sender, deletes each address only after its message went out, and retries failed sends on a re-run [V src/lib/market/open-market.ts]. Nothing can go out yet: `FOLLOW_EMAIL_FROM` (a verified sending domain) is not set in production, an account step for the PM [V PR body; A today]. Checked no: `[guards F076.15 partial: the send and the discard, against a fake database]`; no standing guard that nothing else reads `metro_waitlist.email` [V grep]. Reviewed no (`Reviewed by: build lane`). Shipped: 66e50b13 and 55fb92f2 (#1093 touched the script) green [V]. Smoked unknown: not a route. #616 open (launch-blocking, Beta): the domain step. Filed #1118 (check, launch-blocking, Beta).

criteria.text: Metros are ordered by how many people are waiting
criteria.note: Struck 2026-10-11 (F103 ruling, in the scenario): there is no list of markets to order, since the zip decides. The area picker still lists metros and, since #1031, orders the waiting ones by the cached figure; the surviving rule, that no surface reads the live counters, is under criteria 8 and 14. Shown, not counted.
